snippet.title: Prince Jackson REACTS to Cousin Jaafar Jackson’s ‘Michael’ Performance
snippet.description:
Prince Jackson opens up in a rare interview with ABC News about the emotional impact of seeing his cousin, Jaafar Jackson, step into the role of his late father in biopic 'Michael,' out now. Prince describes the moment as an 'emotional shock.' He adds that he hopes the film will spark both joy and nostalgia for fans, while also offering a deeper understanding of the pop icon’s life and legacy.

snippet.title: Prince Jackson Getting Ready for Michael LA Premiere (Emotional + Funny Moments)
snippet.description:
GRWM with Prince Jackson for the Michael LA Premiere ❤️

Prince getting ready at the family home in Encino for the star-studded Los Angeles premiere of his father’s biopic Michael (April 20, 2026).

Special suit made with Michael’s own fabric & armband, the tie his dad taught him how to tie… and of course the hilarious “I don’t have my pants!” moment 😂

Pure love, legacy & Jackson family energy on the red carpet! 👑

The movie is now in theatres worldwide — have you watched it yet?

snippet.title: Jackson Family Tears Up at Michael Biopic Event #emotional #celebrity #michaeljackson
snippet.description:
The world premiere of the Michael Jackson biopic Michael just happened in Berlin, and it was one of the most emotional red carpet moments in years. Jaafar Jackson arrived with his fiancée. MJ's sons Prince and Bigi honored their father by wearing his iconic armband. And early reactions are calling Jaafar's performance the best of the entire year. Critics are already saying Michael is the greatest musical biopic of ALL TIME. 👑✨

🍿 Michael hits theaters and IMAX on April 24, 2026!
